checks.semantics: App Server initializes over stdio JSONL and reports the pinned platform and version.
checks.pass_condition: initialize succeeds; platform and version match the host contract

checks.semantics: The required native sandbox can actually enter its strongest supported mode.
checks.pass_condition: no sandbox setup warning or fallback; requested policy is enforceable

checks.semantics: A sandboxed command reads a fixture inside the run workspace.
A sandboxed command writes only inside the run workspace.
checks.pass_condition: expected output exists inside workspace and nowhere else

checks.semantics: A sandboxed command cannot read a sibling sentinel outside the workspace.
checks.pass_condition: non-zero command result with an OS permission denial

checks.semantics: A link created inside the workspace cannot expose a target outside it.
checks.pass_condition: read and write through the link are denied

checks.semantics: A Windows junction or reparse point cannot expose a target outside the workspace.
checks.pass_condition: read and write through the junction are denied in elevated sandbox mode

checks.semantics: Sandboxed scientific commands have no outbound network access.
checks.pass_condition: direct TCP attempt is denied by the sandbox

checks.semantics: The pinned immutable Python runtime imports SymPy and solves the same expression.
checks.pass_condition: SymPy version and deterministic roots match the locked fixture

checks.semantics: An explicit keyring or file credential store remains logged in after App Server restart.
checks.pass_condition: account/read remains authenticated without reading or printing tokens

checks.semantics: A completed thread is resumed after process restart without losing branch context.
checks.pass_condition: thread/read and thread/resume recover the recorded completed turn

checks.semantics: A fork from a completed turn creates a new thread with the correct ancestry.
checks.pass_condition: thread/fork succeeds only for the completed lastTurnId and ancestry matches Record
